An endless runner where you steer a spaceship through an asteroid field using the arrow keys (up/down) and fire with space. Colliding with an asteroid or enemy ship ends the game. The objective is to survive as long as possible and rack up points.

1: // Simple endless runner: Cosmic Dodger

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
9:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;

11:   // Audio setup
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'square';
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   function playThrust() { playTone(300, 0.05); }
25:   function playCollision() { playTone(100, 0.3); }
26: 
27:   // Ship definition
28:   const ship = {
29:     x: 80,
30:     y: height / 2,
31:     w: 30,
32:     h: 20,
33:     dy: 0,
34:     speed: 4,
35:     draw() {
36:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(this.x - this.w, this.y - this.h / 2, this.x, this.y);
37:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
38:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#8f8');
39:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
40:       ctx.beginPath();
41:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
42:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.w, this.y - this.h / 2);
43:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.w, this.y + this.h / 2);
44:       ctx.closePath();
45:       ctx.fill();
46:     },
47:     update() {
48:       this.y += this.dy;
49:       // Keep within bounds
50:       if (this.y < this.h / 2) this.y = this.h / 2;
51:       if (this.y > height - this.h / 2) this.y = height - this.h / 2;
52:     }
53:   };
54: 
55:   // Simple thrust particles for visual feedback
56:   const thrustParticles = [];
57:   function spawnThrust() {
58:     thrustParticles.push({
59:       x: ship.x - ship.w,
60:       y: ship.y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * ship.h,
61:       vx: -2 - Math.random() * 2,
62:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
63:       life: 30,
64:     });
65:   }
66:   function updateThrust() {
67:     for (let i = thrustParticles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const p = thrustParticles[i];
69:       p.x += p.vx;
70:       p.y += p.vy;
71:       p.life--;
72:       if (p.life <= 0) thrustParticles.splice(i, 1);

74:   }

95:   function drawStars() {

104:       if (s.x < 0) s.x = width;
105:     });
106: 
107: 
108:   function spawnAsteroid() {
109:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 15;
110:     asteroids.push({
111:       x: width + size,
112:       y: Math.random() * (height - size),
113:       r: size,
114:     });
115:   }
116: 
117:   function updateAsteroids() {
118:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
119:       const a = asteroids[i];
120:       a.x -= asteroidSpeed;

138:       const dx = Math.max(ship.x - ship.w, Math.min(a.x, ship.x));
139:       const dy = Math.max(ship.y - ship.h / 2, Math.min(a.y, ship.y + ship.h / 2));
140:       const dist = Math.hypot(a.x - dx, a.y - dy);
